turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm driving through the night to get to my sister's. Around seven hours. How do I stay alert?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The best thing is planning breaks. Stop roughly every two hours, even if you feel fine, and get out and walk around.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was thinking lots of energy drinks.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A coffee can help for a bit, but caffeine takes about twenty minutes to kick in and it wears off suddenly. It's no substitute for rest.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's your cue to pull over somewhere safe. A twenty minute nap with a coffee just before it works surprisingly well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Coffee before a nap? That sounds backwards.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It sounds odd, but the caffeine kicks in right as you wake up. Also keep the car a bit cool and snack on something light, heavy food makes you drowsy.
